rank-detail-01-slice-close-badge.js.about: the first published version: the action stage ignored rank (void input) and clicked a fixed position; the title was also sliced between 'Close' and a badge phrase, which is refused once the input is used

rank-detail-02-empty-guard.js.about: the identity guard with an empty body; title fell back to a heading scan and returned the site title for every rank

rank-detail-03-verified.js.about: the version validated 4/4 with four distinct topics: throws on mismatch, reads the link, reads heat off the dialog as a number

rank-detail-04-rewrites-title.js.about: the guard's body rewrote the title until identityMatches would pass; URL assembled from the title when no link was found

rank-detail-05-slice-before-badge.js.about: title sliced out of dialog.innerText on one line, anchored on a badge phrase

history-search-01-structural.js.about: titles from h3>mark, counts and dates off each result's own spans; refused three times by the old character-counting rule

keyword-history-01-list-map.js.about: a list output built the ordinary way: Array.from(container.querySelectorAll(…)).map(link => { … }) with a block body, then .filter(…). Authoring refused it twice in a row for unreadable provenance and gave up, because the chain scanner allowed a call to nest parentheses only one level deep
